name: kitware/cmake (book techniques): C++20 modules with CMake 3.28
listed_description: C++20 modules with CMake 3.28 (Ninja 1.11+): modules were introduced to reduce compilation time; the binary module interface significantly reduces recompilation needed by consumers (no numbers given).
reason: The repo carries the code and docs (Help/manual/cmake-cxxmodules.7.rst, Ninja and Visual Studio generators, import std support) but no timing numbers against a header-based build: the CMake docs make no numeric speed claim, and the book's companion examples are trivial. WebSearch found only unrelated figures (a Boost-as-modules prototype claiming up to 3x, ISO mailing-list opinions with no measurements), none measuring CMake's module support against a named baseline.
